description: Reverse-ETL message activation: send a personalized SMS via Twilio to each row of an upstream DataFrame (`client.messages.create(to=..., from_=..., body=...)`). Sends REAL messages the moment this asset materializes -- no upload-for-later-matching indirection, and Twilio bills per message segment.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one SMS send, personalized via message_template.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (messages_sent / messages_failed / rows_skipped_no_recipient). No downstream data -- the send side effect is a real SMS to the recipient's phone.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

from_number.label: From Number
from_number.description: Sending phone number (E.164) or Messaging Service SID provisioned in your Twilio account.

recipient_column.label: Recipient Column
recipient_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's phone number (E.164 recommended).

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: SMS body template. Supports {column_name} substitution from other upstream row columns.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (blast-radius safety cap, not a rate limit).

name: Twilio SMS Send
